statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; current evidence does not establish persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; Tail remains low overnight, while the September 23 U.S. cash open and Flash PMI form the next concentrated conditional risk window.
headline: Low overnight Tail; U.S. open and Flash PMI remain the next conditional risk window
body: Fresh shared breadth context shows semiconductors broadly positive but megacaps split. Early Asian reporting described Nasdaq-100 futures as little changed, while granular current NQ retracement structure is not sufficiently verified. Low volatility and oil relief temper Tail; rates and geopolitical uncertainty keep Stress elevated.

lookbackSummary: Tail was mostly low across the prior 24 clock hours. It reached 27% elevated at 14:00 UTC and WATCH at 15:00-16:00 UTC before returning to low; Stress remained predominantly extreme.
outlookSummary: Overnight Tail remains low unless NQ develops persistent extreme holding or repeated failed retracements. The main conditional danger window is 13:30-15:30 UTC around the U.S. cash open, Flash PMI and early post-release price discovery.
